title: Customer 360
summary: One view of each client: profile, products held, contacts and relationship history.

trust.purpose: The client relationship view the RM works from.

title: Salesforce
summary: Client coverage, meetings, opportunities and pipeline.

trust.purpose: Where coverage, meetings and opportunities are recorded.

title: Konect
summary: The KYC record for each client and where its review stands.

trust.purpose: The KYC system of record used by the KYC review.

title: Credit system
summary: Where credit requests are raised, approved and tracked, with limits and renewals.

trust.purpose: Credit requests, decisions, limits and renewals.

title: Client profitability
summary: Revenue and returns by client and by product.

trust.purpose: Shows what each relationship earns and where returns are thin.

title: Market intelligence
summary: Company news, sector research and market data on your clients.

trust.purpose: Outside view of clients, sectors and competitors.

title: Account plan outline
summary: Turns your notes on a client into a first draft account plan: objectives, products, contacts and next steps.

trust.purpose: A faster first draft of an account plan.
guardrails: Check every draft before it is used.
Use only data you are allowed to see in the source system.
trust.feedback: Recorded by the AI Hub. Routing to the owning team is to be confirmed.

title: Wallet share summary
summary: Sets what a client does with MUFG against what market data suggests they spend, product by product.

trust.purpose: A gap summary to plan coverage from.
guardrails: Estimates are a starting point, not a figure to quote to a client.
Use only data you are allowed to see in the source system.
trust.feedback: Recorded by the AI Hub. Routing to the owning team is to be confirmed.

title: Client meeting brief
summary: Builds a one-page brief from the client's Customer 360 view and open opportunities: where things stand, recent news, three questions to ask.

trust.purpose: Walk into a meeting prepared, from one page.
guardrails: Check every draft before it reaches a client.
Use only data you are allowed to see in the source system.
trust.feedback: Recorded by the AI Hub. Routing to the owning team is to be confirmed.

title: Financing pitch outline
summary: Shapes a client's need into a pitch outline: the problem, the proposed structure and why MUFG.

trust.purpose: A first structure for a pitch.
guardrails: Terms and pricing come from the product and credit teams, not the draft.
Check every draft before it reaches a client.
trust.feedback: Recorded by the AI Hub. Routing to the owning team is to be confirmed.

title: Credit request summary
summary: Drafts the business case section of a credit request from the client's financials and relationship history.

trust.purpose: A faster first draft of the business case.
guardrails: It does not recommend or make credit decisions.
Check every figure against the credit system.
trust.feedback: Recorded by the AI Hub. Routing to the owning team is to be confirmed.

title: Next product conversation
summary: Suggests the next product to discuss with a client and a way to open the conversation.

trust.purpose: Ideas for a relevant next conversation.
guardrails: Check every suggestion against product suitability rules before raising it.
Use only data you are allowed to see in the source system.
trust.feedback: Recorded by the AI Hub. Routing to the owning team is to be confirmed.

title: Portfolio review summary
summary: Summarises returns, limits, renewals and open follow-ups across your book.

trust.purpose: One summary to run the review from.
guardrails: Check every figure against the source system.
Use only data you are allowed to see in the source system.
trust.feedback: Recorded by the AI Hub. Routing to the owning team is to be confirmed.

title: Sector coverage lead
summary: Knows the clients and competitors in a sector. Ask about priorities and wallet.

trust.purpose: Sector knowledge from someone who covers it.
trust.how_to_access: Find them in the SME directory.
guardrails: Experts advise. Decisions stay with the accountable approver.

title: Product specialist
summary: Knows a product family in depth, such as cash management, trade or FX. Ask about fit and structure.

trust.purpose: Product fit and structure from a specialist.
trust.how_to_access: Find them in the SME directory.
guardrails: Experts advise. Decisions stay with the accountable approver.

title: Credit risk partner
summary: Works with RMs on credit requests. Ask what credit will look for before you submit.

trust.purpose: An early read from credit before a request goes in.
trust.how_to_access: Find them in the SME directory.
guardrails: Experts advise. Decisions stay with the accountable approver.

title: KYC operations lead
summary: Knows the KYC review. Ask about documents, timings and follow-ups.

trust.purpose: Answers on the KYC review from the team that runs it.
trust.how_to_access: Find them in the SME directory.
guardrails: Experts advise. Decisions stay with the accountable approver.

title: RM AI champions
summary: Relationship managers sharing prompts and ways of working with AI. Post what works and ask about what does not.

trust.purpose: Where RMs share and improve what works.
guardrails: No client data in posts.

title: Compliance AI Practitioners
summary: Compliance teams using AI for screening, KYC and reviews. Post what works and ask about what does not.

trust.purpose: Where compliance teams share and improve how they use AI.

title: Faster client meeting preparation
summary: A proposed use case: prepare a client meeting from one brief instead of several systems.

trust.purpose: Collects the need, the data involved and the people who want it.
guardrails: Reviewed through MUFG's workflow tool before any build starts. Which tool is to be confirmed.

title: Credit request drafting
summary: A proposed use case: draft the business case section of a credit request from data already in the credit system.

trust.purpose: Collects the need, the data involved and the people who want it.
guardrails: Reviewed through MUFG's workflow tool before any build starts. Which tool is to be confirmed.
